0.0: Hey, #h0#! So I've been lookin' and lookin' for an answer, but I just don't think there's an easy way to save the island.
0.1: Which means, we've got to do it ourselves, the old-fashioned way, with our own two hands. Let's clean and fix and plant and paint!
0.2: The rest of the alliance sent us some tools. #h2#, can you go get them?

yes.0: Athena Pierce has the tools. Go grab 'em, and I'll meetcha on Maple Island.
